title: aerated funky saudi-arabian casserole tagine
description: a flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish made with saudi-arabian spices, shio-cure, and a touch of caster sugar. satvik-friendly recipe

ingredients.name: shio-cure
ingredients.notes: cured in salt and turmeric water, drained and chopped

instructions: heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large saut6 pan over medium heat.
add 1 onion, finely chopped, and saut6 until translucent.
add 2 cloves of garlic, minced, and saut6 for 1 minute.
add 250g of shio-cure, chopped, and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
add 1 cup of long-grain rice, rinsed and drained, and stir to combine.
add 1 teaspoon of ground cumin, 1 teaspoon of ground coriander, and 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric, and stir to combine.
add 1 cup of water and 1 cup of vegetable broth, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and cook for 18-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
add 1/2 cup of diced fresh parsley, 1/4 cup of chopped fresh mint, and 2 tablespoons of caster sugar, and stir to combine.
transfer the contents of the pan to a serving dish and top with toasted almonds and dried rose petals
casserole is ready to be served!
fluff the casserole with a fork before serving.
serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
